newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower, blue chips dip.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower, blue chips dip.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly lower on Wednesday in modest trade which saw blue chips Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka dipping.
* Nine of 15 issues fell, five fell and one ended flat.
* Volume was lower at 7,567 units, with turnover rising slightly to 5.6 million kuna.
* Zagreb's Hotel Intercontinental led losers, falling 11.76 percent from two weeks ago to 150 kuna on volume of 88 shares.
* Top gainer was hotelier Arenaturist, up four kuna or 2.84 percent to 145 kuna on volume of 162 shares.
* Food stock Podravka with 2,919 units sold was the most active issue. It lost five kuna or 1.64 percent to close at 300 kuna.
